name: FFS_CATALOG_ITEM
description: Contains items belonging to particular catalogs.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the catalog item.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Unique text identifier of the item in the catalog version.

columns.name: VERSION_GUID
columns.description: Reference to corresponding FFS_CATALOG_VERSION the catalog item belongs to.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Reference to corresponding FFS_CATALOG_ITEM_TYPE of the catalog item.

columns.name: WEIGHT
columns.description: Weight of the catalog item. Determines priority for the offline search, zero means the catalog item won't be considered for offline search.

columns.name: CREATED
columns.description: Time when the catalog item was created.

columns.name: SCM_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Reference to corresponding INVENTORY_ITEM_ID from Supply Chain Management (SCM) or NULL.

columns.name: SCM_LAST_SYNC_DATE
columns.description: Timestamp when the item was synced with Supply Chain Management last time or NULL.

columns.name: DATA
columns.description: Item data (non searchable fields, image urls, linked items) in JSON.

columns.name: SEARCHABLE_DATA
columns.description: Searchable data(fields defined by customer, tags and etc) in JSON.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: SCM_ORGANIZATION_ID
columns.description: A organizing unit in the internal or external structure of your enterprise. Organization structures provide the framework for performing legal reporting, financial control, and management reporting.
